Watts made this hymn from Psalm 119, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD. 2Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart. 3They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways. 4You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently. … 172 more verses PSALM 119 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 119
